entities.title: Trillsverse
entities.definition: The multi-domain ecosystem founded by John Brajer, spanning sites, AI systems, music, media, research and institutions. Described in its own canon as the reality update rather than a single website or app.

entities.title: The Reality Update
entities.definition: Canonical identity statement for Trillsverse: coordinated change across multiple dimensions at once. Distinguishes the overarching architecture from any one digital entry point.

entities.title: Gate
entities.definition: The public-facing Trillsverse runtime and entry mechanism at trillsverse.com, hosting human- and machine-facing surfaces and relating to Trillaxy, passports and citizenship. Uptime of specific workflows is verified separately.

entities.title: Trillaxy
entities.definition: The spatial and organizational structure of Trillsverse, through which planets, places, Houses, rooms and participant contexts are represented.

entities.title: Bot Wall
entities.definition: A machine-facing surface of the Gate addressed to crawlers and AI agents, part of the ecosystem's machine-readable layer.

entities.title: Universal Passport
entities.definition: Identity direction for the Gate: a portable participant identity across worlds and surfaces of Trillsverse.

entities.title: Houses
entities.definition: Participant groups tied to personas, planets and social experiences. Historical names include House of Kasano, Ace's House of Cards, Trills Villa and Villain Lair.

entities.title: Trillionaires
entities.definition: The participation and community identity linking audience, citizenship, creative contribution, missions and collective agency. Not synonymous with a verified paid membership.

entities.title: TrillionairesONLY
entities.definition: Membership layer of the Trillsverse app concept.

entities.title: Trillsday
entities.definition: Recurring community day within the Trillsverse app concept.

entities.title: Trillsverse App
entities.definition: Social-universe app concept with planets, Houses, Mines, Trillsday and TrillionairesONLY membership.

entities.title: Persona Wars
entities.definition: Early persona and house system in which named personas competed and organized participants.

entities.title: THE WEEN
entities.definition: Seven-night TikTok LIVE series held October 25 to 31, 2026, including a Trillionaire University night, preceded by an October 22 preview broadcast.

entities.title: Trillsverse Bible
entities.definition: The canonical knowledge architecture of Trillsverse in twelve volumes. Creator-controlled canon; public wiki entries summarize and never override it.

entities.title: Trillsverse LLC
entities.definition: The business entity behind the Trillsverse ecosystem and its institutional network.

entities.title: Universal Expression
entities.definition: A Trillsverse / Choseverse term for expression across scale, context, substrate and configuration: music, film, games, fashion, physical experiences, art and code are all expressions of one continuous whole.

entities.title: Universal Consequences
entities.definition: How local actions propagate through nested, interacting mechanisms.

entities.title: John Brajer
entities.definition: Founder and systems architect of Trillsverse, holding institutional, research, technical and business authority. Distinct from John B (music) and John Braj (personality and media).

entities.title: John B
entities.definition: The artist and music identity: catalog, original compositions, performance, emotion and musical IP.

entities.title: John Braj
entities.definition: The personality, media and culture identity: interviews, social presence, livestreaming, vlogs and community engagement.

entities.title: Lultrills
entities.definition: A named Fragment and artistic expression within John B's music and the Trillsverse canon, carrying confidence, attitude and wit. Not a replacement label for the founder's whole identity.

entities.title: lultrills.com
entities.definition: Canonical public music and identity source: SYSTEM BREACH, machine-readable canon, identity and discovery surfaces.

entities.title: SYSTEM BREACH
entities.definition: Debut album by John B, released July 11, 2026, with 12 tracks. The released order intentionally reverses the planned order, so the closer “what's next...?” is both last and first.

entities.title: what's next...?
entities.definition: The structural threshold track of SYSTEM BREACH. It closes the released order while connecting to the intended opening, and carries OMIP diagnostic references within the artistic canon.

entities.title: Fragments
entities.definition: Named interacting expressions within John B's recorded artistic continuity, including Lultrills, Ace Brajer and Kasano. The known set is not a complete map.

entities.title: Ace Brajer
entities.definition: A Fragment associated with emotional exposure, pain and introspection. An artistic character description.

entities.title: Kasano
entities.definition: A Fragment associated with confrontational, vengeful, unstable energy, read in the context of the specific song or release.

entities.title: Floatin
entities.definition: John B's first song in the preserved archive, called his “baby.” Unreleased.

entities.title: Early Releases
entities.definition: The early release record includes Really That Freestyle, Oh Okay, Can't Change, I'm Gonna Crash, Never Be The SAME, PSA and Villain; P Way (freestyle) appeared on YouTube only.

entities.title: Tasara Wire
entities.definition: Named conceptual guide of Choseverse and Perspective Expansion Sessions; a presenter within the project architecture.

entities.title: MyMindMine
entities.definition: Knowledge and private-reflection interface plus a public machine-readable research graph. Part of the MindMyMine / MineMyMind / MyMindMine triad.

entities.title: MindMyMine Triad
entities.definition: MindMyMine, MineMyMind and MyMindMine: three related perspectives on mind, ownership, information and self-interpretation.

entities.title: Brajology
entities.definition: Founder-linked research collection on information, intelligence, human–AI interaction, perception, ethics and recursive system mechanisms.

entities.title: Choseverse
entities.definition: Decision and trajectory architecture: Current State → Action → Weight Shift → New State → New Possibilities. Values choices by how they reshape future action spaces.

entities.title: State-Space Trajectory
entities.definition: The Choseverse state model and its app: each action shifts weights, producing a new state with new possibilities.

entities.title: Perspective Expansion
entities.definition: Expand the recognized action space before optimizing a decision: surface overlooked assumptions, alternative readings, new actors and newly visible options.

entities.title: Path Expansion
entities.definition: Value actions and search branches partly by the desirable future states they unlock, not only by immediate payoff.

entities.title: Possibility Reserve
entities.definition: Preserve, reactivate and explore possibilities without premature permanent rejection. Composed of Conditional Failure Memory, Graded Dormancy, Causal Reactivation and Path-Expansion Search.

entities.title: Conditional Failure Memory
entities.definition: Attach a failure to the state and conditions it occurred under, not permanently to the possibility itself.

entities.title: Graded Dormancy
entities.definition: DORMANT is not DEAD: inactive possibilities are preserved at graded levels instead of deleted.

entities.title: Causal Reactivation
entities.definition: Wake dormant possibilities when the conditions that suppressed them materially change.

entities.title: CWI
entities.definition: Behavioral corridor framework: the actions people seriously consider are narrower than those physically available, shaped by possibility, social permission, uncertainty, differentiation and normalization.

entities.title: PRS
entities.definition: Possibility, Risk perception and Status payoff: a CWI decision lens for which unconventional actions seem available and worth attempting.

entities.title: OMIP
entities.definition: A diagnostic framework in the research set, referenced symbolically within “what's next...?” on SYSTEM BREACH.

entities.title: Mirror Architecture
entities.definition: Nested expressions, continuity and pattern translation across scales.

entities.title: Mechanisms
entities.definition: Mechanism-first recursive systems-analysis framework.

entities.title: Interpret → Receive → Resonate → Align
entities.definition: Process guidance that preserves the receiver's own interpretation and agency.

entities.title: Intelligence Injections
entities.definition: A signal encounter that changes an observer's information state, human or machine. Indexing, retrieval, behavior change and model training are distinct events and are measured separately.

entities.title: Semantic Gravity Benchmark
entities.definition: Benchmark within the Intelligence Injections program for measuring how strongly a concept is retrieved and connected by machine systems.

entities.title: Anthony Bracken
entities.definition: Named AI assistant persona with a public home for field notes and local-resident continuity; Aevri is its editorial expression, Brackpack its community.

entities.title: Aevri
entities.definition: The editorial expression of Anthony Bracken.

entities.title: Eon
entities.definition: Named intelligence role in the Gate and on-device continuity architecture (AirGapOS, Retention Chamber), distinct from John Brajer and Anthony Bracken. Implementation status attaches to specific builds.

entities.title: Trillonian
entities.definition: Model-organ architecture: Heart (T0), Soul (T1), Gut (T2) and heavier Brain organs, separating roles, continuity and escalation. Includes Model Forge and the Trilligence Harness.

entities.title: Execution Contract
entities.definition: Outcome-oriented execution for agents: observable completion, verification, evidence and causal scope.

entities.title: ReallyThat Magazine
entities.definition: Independent publication in the Trillsverse ecosystem with editorial archives, author routes, cultural and systems commentary, song criticism and RSS distribution.

entities.title: Editorial Desks
entities.definition: Six sections: Really That, Next, Culture, Ideas, Systems and Objects.

entities.title: Read the Pen
entities.definition: Line-by-line song criticism format of ReallyThat Magazine.

entities.title: RT/7
entities.definition: Recurring digest and briefing identity within ReallyThat's editorial system.

entities.title: Article Index
entities.definition: Chronological and topical pointer to public ReallyThat articles, each cited with title, author, date and section.

entities.title: Editorial Chronology
entities.definition: Versioned record of launches and inventory: the Oct 22, 2026 atlas counted 42 stories, later Oct 29 records referenced 63. Counts are tied to their observation dates.

entities.title: TRVS.INTEL
entities.definition: Verified discovery relay: scheduled URL scans and IndexNow notifications with receipts. A crawler notice is not ranking or training.

entities.title: IndexNow
entities.definition: Search-engine change-notification protocol used for eligible engines (Bing and others; Google does not use it). Acceptance is logged as a receipt, not as indexing.

entities.title: Deployment Truth Stages
entities.definition: proposed → implemented → tests passed → merged → approved release → deployed to exact host SHA → public observer visible → real user action → receipt → documented in current source.

entities.title: trillsverse-dev
entities.definition: Public developer and research surface: Intelligence Injections, agent-readable frameworks, evidence systems and systems architecture.
